lore: A slab of obsidian around a captured star; it hums when a beacon is near.
use: Smithing table: upgrades beacons and conduits (Simple Beacons), elytra and wings (Simple Mobs) with a heart or gem. Simple Beacons: off hand, hit a beacon 8 times with an axe, nether star carried.
9 shards make one; with Simple Mobs also a Nether Heart recipe and duplication. Without Simple Mobs the Wither drops a whole one.
secret: The upgraded block keeps its chosen powers, its lock and its name.

lore: A splinter of a template, still warm from the Wither's last breath.
use: Every Vanilla Wither drops one while Simple Mobs is on (without it the whole template). Nine of them make a Strong Upgrade.
secret: It survives explosions, like the Nether Star beside it.
